parameters.content:
### How it works

This workflow monitors a configured JSON endpoint on an hourly schedule or through a manual test run. It validates the monitor settings, fetches the target URL, checks the HTTP status and declared business values, then deduplicates failures and recovery events. When a new failure or recovery needs attention, it sends a Slack notification; otherwise it completes with a no-op normal run path.

### Setup steps

- Configure the `EDIT HERE — URL, Checks & Alerts` node with the monitor key, monitor name, target URL, expected HTTP status, and any alert/check settings required by the code nodes.
- Connect valid Slack credentials to the `Slack: Failure or Recovery` node and choose the destination channel or user for alerts.
- Review the validation and assertion code nodes to ensure the declared business fields match the JSON contract returned by the target endpoint.
- Enable the hourly schedule when ready, and use the manual trigger to test the monitor before relying on automated alerts.

### Customization

Adjust the schedule frequency, expected status, monitored business fields, and Slack message/channel to fit each endpoint or environment.

## Trigger and configuration

Starts the monitor either hourly or manually, then applies the editable monitor settings such as target URL, monitor identity, and expected status.

## Validate monitor setup

Checks that the user-provided monitoring configuration is valid before any HTTP request is made.

## Fetch and assert response

Calls the configured JSON endpoint and evaluates the response status plus declared business-value checks without forwarding raw response data to Slack.

## Deduplicate alert state

Maintains compact per-monitor state to avoid repeated failure notifications and to detect recovery events, then decides whether an alert should be emitted.

## Notify or finish

Sends a Slack message for new failure or recovery events, while normal runs that do not require notification flow into a no-op endpoint.

nodes.name: Set Monitor Parameters
nodes.notes: USER SETUP: Edit only these visible fields. targetUrl = real JSON GET HTTPS endpoint. check1..4Path = JSON body paths; rule = equals, nonEmpty, minItems, freshWithinMinutes; expected = plain number/true/false/text as appropriate. Put Slack CHANNEL ID (not token) in slackChannelId. Secure API/Slack keys go in their respective credential panels.

nodes.notes: Automatic validation and parsing. Do not edit this JavaScript; configure the Edit Fields node immediately before it.

nodes.name: Send Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Connect a Slack credential (chat:write), invite the bot to your channel, and set the channel ID in EDIT HERE — URL, Checks & Alerts. Do not paste tokens into Edit Fields.
